description: Find companies newly registered in official business registers: UK Companies House (when the server has a COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY), Norway Brreg, Finland PRH, and France BODACC company creation notices. Filter by registered_within_days, industry_codes (NACE based prefixes such as 62 or 70.2, which work across UK SIC 2007, Norway SN2007, and Finland TOL 2008; France has no codes and is skipped when they are set), activity_keywords (register activity text, France and Norway), name_keywords, and locations. Returns one row per company: register, country, company_number, company_name, registration_date, company_type, company_status, industry_codes, industry_description, activity_description, address, postal_code, city, region, website and domain when listed, share_capital, and register_url. Sole traders are never returned. When nothing matches, one free no_results row says why. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per company row returned plus a run start.

active_only.description: Drop entries already marked dissolved, bankrupt, or in liquidation. Default true.

activity_keywords.description: Words in the activity text the register publishes, in its own language, for example logiciel (France) or programvare (Norway).

industry_codes.description: Industry code prefixes such as 62, 70.2, or 56. France BODACC has no codes and is skipped when this is set.

locations.description: City or region names, or short postal code prefixes such as EC1 or 75.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before any row that would take its charges over this amount.

max_companies.description: Company rows per run, newest first, up to 5000. Each company row is billed. Default 200.

only_new.description: Skip companies an earlier run with the same state_key returned. Default false.

registered_within_days.description: Registration window in days, 1 to 90, today included. Default 7.

registers.description: Registers to read. Default all four. UK Companies House is read only when the server has COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY set.

state_key.description: Names the seen list for only_new.

name: find_new_company_registrations
title: Find newly registered companies
